metadata.description: Reusable Agent Skills and Plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: Adversarial PR review — Claude and Gemini discover findings independently then cross-examine each other symmetrically, surfacing only issues both models confirm. Auto-detects PR vs local (working-tree) mode; degrades loudly to Claude-only if the Gemini adversary is unavailable.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Color-coded context window usage bar for Claude Code statusline and /context-bar command

plugins.name: context-shield
plugins.description: Prevents context window overflow by delegating token-heavy reads to isolated sub-agents that return distilled summaries. Auto-detects when ralph-loop is needed. Covers: documentation sites, code audits, dependency research, large PR reviews, competitive analysis, security advisories.

plugins.name: custom-statusline
plugins.description: 4-tier adaptive statusline with icons for folder, git branch, and context usage

plugins.name: deep-review
plugins.description: Two-phase convergence harness for high-assurance review of a changeset (PR or working-tree diff). Phase 1 loops iterative multi-reviewer fix->re-review until a round finds zero actionable issues; Phase 2 runs a Gemini-primary adversarial cross-examination (Gemini finds -> Claude judges -> Gemini counters), fixing every confirmed finding. Soft-depends on pr-review-toolkit and adversarial-review plugins with documented fallbacks.

plugins.name: figma-ui-designer
plugins.description: Interactive Figma UI design skill with brainstorming, progress tracking, and design-to-code bridging via Figma MCP

plugins.name: obsidian-brain
plugins.description: Persistent brain for Claude Code sessions using Obsidian. Auto-logs sessions, captures curated insights, enables project-scoped context resume, and provides fast cross-project search via tags and metadata.

plugins.name: product-video-creation
plugins.description: Creates polished, narrated product demo videos using Remotion with AI-crafted storytelling, real app screenshots, animated phone mockups, brand-aligned styling, TTS voiceover, and background music.

plugins.name: skill-authoring
plugins.description: Creates and optimizes Claude Code skills following Anthropic's official best practices with emphasis on agent parallelization and script-first determinism

plugins.name: skill-publishing
plugins.description: Plugin-first publishing for Claude Code skills. Auto-assembles and syncs plugins from plugin-manifest.json files. Also supports bare skills and individual repos

plugins.name: smart-screen-recorder
plugins.description: AI-driven screen recording and demo production pipeline for macOS. Records screen + cursor, analyzes with AI vision, generates zoom scripts and voiceover narration, and produces polished demo videos.

plugins.name: spec-creator
plugins.description: Creates detailed story specifications with TDD implementation steps, success metrics, Figma UX design gates, and vertical splitting from various inputs (plans, requirements, GitHub issues).

plugins.name: spec-review
plugins.description: Reviews and enriches story specifications with codebase-verified sub-tasks, architecture alignment, design simplification, and API test plans.

plugins.name: statusline-creator
plugins.description: Creates and customizes Claude Code statusline scripts from composable items
